channel.title: MarketCentaur Insights
channel.description: Practical guides on AI, automation, growth and competitive intelligence from MarketCentaur.

item.title: Your Business Now Has a Profile in ChatGPT. Is It Right?
item.description: OpenAI now lets businesses claim a ChatGPT profile, add product feeds and launch an agent. What changed, what to check first and how to measure it.

item.title: Where Should a Small Business Start with AI? A 30-Day Plan
item.description: A practical 30-day plan for starting with AI in a small or mid-sized business: pick one problem, set ground rules, run a small pilot and measure it.

item.title: 12 Competitor Signals Worth Tracking (and 5 to Ignore)
item.description: Which public competitor signals actually predict a change in strategy, which ones are mostly noise, and how to tell the difference.

item.title: How to Run Competitive Intelligence Without an Analyst Team
item.description: A lightweight, weekly competitor-tracking system a one-person marketing team can set up in an afternoon, and how to turn what you collect into decisions.
